literal_meaning: জাল বা ওত পাতা (net spreading or setting a trap)
figurative_meaning_en: Waiting for or seeking an opportunity
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চাকরির সুযোগের জন্য ওতপাতা করছে।
ব্যবসায়িক লাভের অপেক্ষায় তারা ওতপাতা করে বসে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is lying in wait for a job opportunity.
They are biding their time for a business gain.
history: Originating from traditional Bengali rural practices of setting nets for birds or fish, symbolizing patient anticipation.
note: The idiom draws from agrarian and fishing lifestyles in Bengal.
